//: C1 guard — keeps NEW CSS on the design tokens in globals.css instead of raw hex/px, so the palette/spacing can't drift again. Rules are 'warning' severity so the existing ~140 modules don't block the build; tighten to 'error' once migrated. Requires: npm i -D stylelint (and optionally stylelint-config-standard). Run: npm run lint:css

color-no-hex.message: Use a --color/--kpi/--accent token from globals.css instead of a raw hex value.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use a --space-*/--radius token instead of a raw px value.
